data.body: A6-0c oracle card (strong-tier, pre-code). Authoritative contract: signed ticket plan plus measured rehearsal in session 1cb6 (49,888 commits/2,661 merges, 98,803,422-byte pack, byte-identical HEAD tree after dynamic re-add). Existing-coverage inventory: no reclaim/fast-export implementation or tests exist; nearest Git history tests cover unrelated recovery seams, so this leaf needs new unit + real-repository integration coverage. Trigger preconditions: fresh unfiltered --no-tags scratch clone; old tip has current dynamic .bridge_state set and no .bridge_state.bak-retarget at HEAD; historical revisions contain both target prefixes; graph includes a merge; adversarial message begins with `M ` bytes. Production path: CLI -> byte-length-aware fast-export filter -> fast-import rewritten ref -> dynamic old-tip ls-tree re-add -> graph/tree/history/tag/pack assertions; no push. Test tiers: unit BinaryIO stream filter because message-vs-command classification is pure framing; temporary real Git repositories for refs/DAG/trees/reachability/pack/push. One tier lower cannot prove ref immutability or object reachability. Exact postconditions: commit+merge counts unchanged, new tree equals old tree, target history absent except HEAD re-add, source branch/tag exact, no local protected tag, measured pack <= ceiling, final success emitted only after all checks, writer push works with <1 MiB incremental pack and old tip is not ancestor. Collateral invariants: source remote refs immutable, no production push, scratch worktree/index clean, no merge/rebase state. Recovery: any failed assertion exits nonzero before success; rerun starts from a fresh clone. Contention exemption: this is an offline scratch rewrite with no publication and no shared-store mutation; A6-1 owns quiescence and leased publication. Surface census: CLI in scope via subprocess; library facade and MCP/API out of scope because this is a one-time operational script; automated publication caller out of scope until A6-1; dual direction in scope via rewrite plus a representative post-rewrite review-bot event push. Gate: exact unit/integration nodes, then make lint/typecheck/test. Implementer tier: standard/mid, since binary framing and multi-repo Git integration span multiple files; edge/E2E oracle stays physically held out.
